title: Ridgeline Tool Rental On-Schedule Return and the Excess Kept on Damage
content:
Returning Ridgeline Tool Rental equipment on schedule lowers the excess the renter keeps on a protected damage repair charge.

Returning on schedule lowers the excess the renter keeps: equipment returned on or before the due-back date takes 150.00 dollars off it; equipment returned on the calendar day right after the due-back date takes 75.00 dollars off; equipment returned later takes nothing off.

The return date and the due-back date are the date parts of the return and due-back times on the agreement.

The amount taken off is subtracted from the excess the renter keeps after the renter's share of the excess has been figured, and the excess the renter keeps never goes below zero. No amount on the way is rounded; the adjustment is rounded to the cent only at the end.

## Return table

| Return date | Taken off the excess kept |
|---|---|
| on or before the due-back date | 150.00 |
| the calendar day right after the due-back date | 75.00 |
| two or more calendar days after the due-back date | nothing |

## Hypothetical cases (due-back 21 April at 17:00, share of the excess 1200.00)

| Returned | Taken off | Excess kept |
|---|---|---|
| 21 April 20:15 | 150.00 | 1050.00 |
| 22 April 08:00 | 75.00 | 1125.00 |
| 24 April 09:30 | nothing | 1200.00 |
